changelog:
yoooclaw-work-report-en 1.0.0

- Initial release of automatic work report generation from mobile notifications.
- Extracts daily or weekly work progress, key communications, approvals, to-dos, and risks from common work apps.
- Supports user configuration for report type, tracked apps/groups, and data source selection.
- Filters out non-work, social, and irrelevant notifications for concise summaries.
- Outputs structured daily/weekly reports in a professional, ready-to-send format.
